title: FRINGE
subtitle: skipto.tv
blurb: All 100 Fringe cases, episode by episode: which hours are case-of-the-week and which move the mythology, which side of the breach you're on, the timeline where Peter never grew up, and the Observer-occupied world of 2036.
regularsNote: Series regulars (Olivia, Peter, Walter, Broyles, Astrid, Nina, Charlie and later Lincoln) aren't listed per episode by TVmaze, so use the chart rows and spotlight tags for them. The alternate-universe doubles (Fauxlivia, Walternate, Alt-Broyles, Alt-Lincoln and the rest) are credited as guests, so they're in the dropdown, along with September, Jones, Newton, Sam Weiss, Windmark and Etta.
chartHint: 100 columns — scroll sideways. Blue is our side, red is Over There. Use the Case of the week and Mythology vibes for the big split. Click any bar to filter episodes; shift-click to combine.
credits: Episode data, images, ratings and guest cast from TVmaze. Chart hand-built from the series.
